Rank 13 - Service

Repair Shop Job Card and Warranty

Repair shops need job cards, device photos, parts used, warranty dates, pickup reminders, and technician commissions.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 6,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 300Recommended monthly charge

BDT 300/month is realistic. Cloud photo backup should be a higher tier.

7.7Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 6,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 300Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 9,600,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target mobile repair, electronics repair, computer service, motorcycle workshops, and AC repair desks.

Warranty arguments happen because proof, parts, and repair history are scattered.

Every repair has proof: photo, issue, parts, warranty, due, and technician.

Validation signals

  • Repair shops cluster in every town.
  • Warranty dispute is real pain.
  • Photo proof is easy to understand.
  • Commission tracking hooks owners.

MVP modules

  • Job card
  • Device photo
  • Problem note
  • Parts used
  • Warranty date
  • Pickup reminder
  • Technician commission

Do not build first

  • Do not build repair marketplace.
  • Do not add heavy inventory first.
  • Do not require long forms.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Start in mobile repair markets.
  • Use one-minute job card.
  • Add printed receipt later.
  • Sell photo backup as pro.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Technicians avoid data entry.
  • Photos use storage.
  • Parts inventory pressure.
Mitigations
  • Camera-first input.
  • Compress photos.
  • Simple parts list.
